limitations.text: No historical glyph image is proposed. The Commons candidate 休-bronze.svg is a modern vector redraw, and search results indicate public-domain status, but its exact description page could not be opened to verify and copy the original direct image link. The official Xiaoxuetang guide grants CC0 1.0 to query-interface glyph images, but the specific 休 record and image URL were inaccessible. These failures prevent a compliant reusable image proposal.
